title: Lọ thuốc thứ Năm
description: Bản ghi hợp nhất, theo thứ tự quy trình, của mọi request PixelLab đã gửi cho case này. Dựng từ art/**/request.json, *.receipt.json, rot/metadata.json và sheet/*.json; không thêm ID nào không có trong các tệp đó.
artRoot: art/ = thư mục bản gốc PixelLab của case (PNG gốc, request, receipt), giữ ngoài src/FE/public.

conventions.prompt: Văn bản gửi vào tham số ghi ở promptParam (description cho create_image_pro / edit_image / create_character, action cho animate_character).
conventions.cost_generations: Lấy từ receipt (cost_generations, hoặc charged_generations nếu receipt chỉ có trường đó).
conventions.receipt: Sao nguyên văn receipt gốc để đối chiếu.
conventions.outputs: Tệp PixelLab trả về, giữ nguyên trong art/.
conventions.derivedLocal: Tệp xử lý cục bộ từ outputs (không AI).
conventions.runtimeAssets: Tệp game đọc dưới src/FE/public (sinh bởi build_assets.py).

styleReference.description: Sprite Sherlock V3 96 hướng south có sẵn, dùng làm tham chiếu phong cách cho mọi sprite mặt trước.

requests.prompt: Top-down, front-facing pixel art map, not isometric. A compact Victorian riverside street block on a clear morning, one complete scene filling the whole square canvas. North edge: a calm river with a small wooden ferry pier and a moored rowing ferry boat, an iron railing along the stone quay. Below it a cobblestone riverside street runs from left to right. Centre: a small paved square with a cast-iron clock post, two wooden benches, gas lamps and a few flower planters. Four separate buildings, each fully visible with roof, front wall, windows and ONE clearly visible front door opening onto the street or square, spaced apart with walkable pavement between them: 1) West: a large two-storey red-brick townhouse with a slate roof, white window frames and a tiny front garden behind a low iron fence; attached to its south side a small wooden carriage house with wide open doors and a black two-wheeled carriage parked in front. 2) East: a narrow apothecary shop with a dark green shopfront, two display windows full of glass bottles and a hanging lantern. 3) South-east: a photographer's studio with a glass skylight roof section, large front windows and a striped awning. 4) South-west: a pawnbroker's shop with a dark timber shopfront, barred windows and a hanging sign of three brass balls. Cobblestone streets connect every door, and a street leaves the map at the bottom centre. Small details: barrels, crates, a hand cart, street trees, window flower boxes, a few puddles. No people, no animals, no readable text or letters on any sign. Clear walkable paths; buildings never overlap each other.

Dr. John Watson, a Victorian doctor in his late thirties with a sturdy medium build, short brown hair under a dark bowler hat, a neat moustache and a calm friendly face. He wears a dark green tweed three-piece suit with a buttoned waistcoat, white shirt and dark necktie, and brown leather shoes, and carries a small black leather doctor's bag in his right hand at his side. Detailed pixel art character sprite in the same style as the reference, full body, standing straight and facing the viewer (south-facing, straight-on), low top-down view, natural adult proportions, centred on a transparent background with the feet near the bottom edge.

references.usage: art style reference only: match this sprite's pixel density, single dark outline, shading, colour treatment, low top-down camera and overall adult body scale on the canvas; do NOT copy his face, hat, coat or identity

requests.prompt: Convert this exact map into a flat black-and-white object mask with the same framing and coordinates. Paint WHITE every visible solid object: buildings with roofs and walls, chimneys, shop fronts, window boxes, iron fences and railings, gates, lamp posts, the clock post, trees and bushes, benches, flower planters, barrels, crates, signs on brackets, the hand cart, the carriage and its wheels, the boat and the wooden pier. Paint BLACK all open ground: cobblestones, paving, the square floor, puddles and the river water. Gaps where the ground shows between objects stay black. Pure white and pure black only, no grey, no outlines, no texture, no shading.

references.source: map-v1/map-512.png (job 42741c32-149d-4c36-aaa9-e77e592b4899 index 0), native 512x512, no upscale, no characters

requests.prompt: Interior of a Victorian collector's townhouse room, a combined gallery and study. Along the right wall a tall wooden curio shelf full of old books, a small brass birdcage and ceramic jars. Facing that shelf, a high-backed green upholstered armchair with a small round side table beside it holding one small empty glass medicine vial and a drinking glass. Against the left wall a brick fireplace with a mantel clock, and a glass-fronted display cabinet with a small brass three-dial combination lock. Near the back corner a writing desk with drawers, an inkwell and papers, and a dressing table with a small open jewellery box. A patterned rug on the wooden floor and a tall window on the back wall. Isometric 2:1 pixel art interior cutaway room seen from above at the front: one floor and two back walls only (a left wall and a right wall meeting at the back corner), no roof and no front walls. Floor edges and wall bases run along true 2:1 isometric axes (26.565 degrees). The entrance threshold at the front edge of the floor is open and clear, with a clear walkable floor area in the middle of the room. Warm morning light from the windows. No people, no animals, no readable text or letters. Detailed pixel art matching the reference's pixel style.

references.usage: exterior of the same building: use only for its identity, materials, colours and pixel-art style; do not copy the outdoor camera

requests.prompt: Inventory icon sheet for a Victorian detective game: sixteen separate small objects arranged in a neat 4 by 4 grid, each object centred in its own 64 by 64 cell with empty space around it, all drawn at the same scale, front three-quarter view, dark outline, warm muted Victorian palette. Row 1: brass magnifying glass with dark wooden handle; tiny glass medicine vial with cork and a torn paper seal strip over the cork; small paper receipt slip with a scribbled signature; small brown leather coachman logbook. Row 2: thick pawnbroker ledger bound in dark green cloth; pawn ticket card tied with red string; folded blank white letter; brown glass chemical bottle with dropper cap. Row 3: folded letter covered in faint brown handwriting scribbles; small round glue pot with a brush; open small wooden jewelry box with red velvet lining, empty; small black leather notebook with a ribbon bookmark. Row 4: gold ring with a green jade stone; folded legal document with a red wax seal; small wooden tray holding seven tiny medicine vials in a row; old brass key. No text, no letters, no numbers, no grid lines, no background.

references.style_note: style from interior nha-so-7 (job 39282314) so icons share palette/outline/shading with the rooms
